title.en: Su Wu in a snowy landscape

alt.en: A small figure and sheep occupy a snowy mountain landscape beneath an imperial poem.
alt.zh: 雪山间有小型人物与羊群，上方题写御诗。

caption.en: Li Zongwan’s Qing-dynasty depiction of Su Wu, with a Qianlong imperial inscription. It recalls Han captivity from an eighteenth-century viewpoint.
caption.zh: 清励宗万绘苏武故事，附乾隆御题；以十八世纪视角追忆汉代被拘经历。

interpretation.en: The desolate snow setting and the inscription about Su Wu emphasize endurance in captivity. They visualize the later moral memory of the envoy.
interpretation.zh: 荒寒雪景与苏武题诗强调被拘时的坚忍，呈现后世对这位使者的道德记忆。

title.en: Zhu Xi’s letter during the 1194 succession

alt.en: Swift vertical lines of Chinese cursive writing cover a mounted paper sheet.
alt.zh: 装裱纸页上纵列草书，运笔迅疾。

caption.en: First sheet of Zhu Xi’s Letter on Government Affairs, written in the eighth lunar month of 1194 after leaving Tanzhou.
caption.zh: 朱熹《政事帖》第一幅，写于1194年农历八月离任潭州之后。

interpretation.en: The letter refers to Xiaozong’s death and Zhu Xi’s hopes after Ningzong’s accession. It gives the 1194 succession a contemporary voice concerned with local government and entering court.
interpretation.zh: 信中提及孝宗之死及宁宗即位后朱熹的期待，以关心地方政务和入朝的当事人声音回应1194年的政局。

title.en: Riverbank in Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains

alt.en: A small boat crosses open water beside a tree-lined bank, with low hills in the distance.
alt.zh: 小舟行于开阔水面，岸边树木成列，远处可见低山。

caption.en: Official photographed section 11 of Huang Gongwang’s Wuyongshi scroll, worked on from 1347 and inscribed in 1350.
caption.zh: 黄公望《富春山居图》无用师卷的官方第11段摄影；作品自1347年起经营，1350年题记。

interpretation.en: In his 1350 inscription Huang says the scroll was still unfinished after three or four years. Open water, dry brushwork and repeated trees show how he developed its river landscape.
interpretation.zh: 黄公望在1350年题记中说，画卷历经三四年仍“未得完备”。留白水面、干笔与成列树木，展示他经营江岸景观的方法。

title.en: The Pavilion of Prince Teng in later painting

alt.en: A many-storeyed pavilion overlooks a river, with mountains and tiny boats beyond.
alt.zh: 多层楼阁临江而立，远处有山峦与小舟。

caption.en: Anonymous painting probably copied in the Yuan dynasty and later mounted in an album; it evokes the pavilion associated with Wang Bo’s Tang prose.
caption.zh: 佚名楼阁图，馆藏说明认为可能为元代摹本，后收入画册；对应王勃唐代名篇所写的滕王阁。

interpretation.en: The museum explicitly relates the pavilion to Wang Bo’s preface. The architectural detail represents a later pictorial model rather than a measured reconstruction of the building in 675.
interpretation.zh: 博物馆将此阁与王勃《滕王阁序》明确联系；建筑细节属于后世图式，并非675年原建筑的测绘复原。
